review_mode: Independent second review of RGB+polygon QA sheets; no mesh, DMD37, error maps, or model outputs shown.
rejection_reasons: Wide ROI includes non-torso body pixels such as arms, hips, and legs in quadruped/kneeling/prone views.
RGB-only boundary does not reliably separate posterior torso from anterior chest or lateral abdomen in oblique views.
A person-mask intersection cannot solve semantic torso-vs-limb partition and therefore cannot be treated as posterior GT.
decision: Do not run posterior O/A/C/G benchmark. Do not tune polygon heuristics until a human annotator can draw and review a true torso boundary or a separate validated torso segmentation source is supplied.
claim_limit: No posterior geometry ranking, clothed torso accuracy, bare-back accuracy, DMD37 accuracy, or medical conclusion is supported.
